Chicken dinner.title: chicken bbq
steps: mix chicken, garlic, and onion in a large saucepan.
simmer for 5 minutes.
remove from heat and simmer for 1 hour.
add tomato and chicken mixture.
reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes or until sauce thickens.
add chicken mixture and simmer for 1 minute more.
add tomato and cook for another minute.
remove from heat.
stir in chicken mixture and simmer until chicken is tender.
serve with rice, noodles, and rice.

Vegetable pasta.title: pasta with tomato
steps: heat oven to 400°f.
mix pasta with tomato.
cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes.
add basil.
cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute.
add garlic and basil.
cook, stirring often, for 1 minute more.
add remaining ingredients and cook for 1 minute more or until tomatoes are tender.
add pasta to the pasta mixture and stir to combine.
remove from heat and stir in tomatoes.
sprinkle with basil.
bake uncovered for 5 minutes.

Cheese omelet.title: spinach and spinach salad
steps: mix together eggs and cheese in a bowl.
mix spinach, onion and spinach in a large mixing bowl.
stir in spinach, onion and tomatoes.
sprinkle with remaining cheese.
place in oven at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes.
cool completely before serving.

Roasted vegetables.title: potato fries
steps: combine potatoes, carrots and olive oil in a large bowl.
combine rosemary, potatoes and onion.
pour over potato fries.
cover and refrigerate for at least 24 hours.
